commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
90+4' The corner from Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is cleared away by the defence.
90+3' A first-time shot by Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players.
90+2' The manager has decided to make a substitution and James Ward-Prowse walks off the pitch to be replaced by Andrew Irving (West Ham).
90+2' The linesman signals that Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
90+2' A fine pass finds Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Mads Hermansen reacts superbly to deny him.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
89' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Pedro Porro (Tottenham).
87' Great teamplay by Tottenham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
86' 7:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.

68' A substitution has been made. Lucas Paqueta is replaced by Callum Wilson (West Ham).

64' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) is about to take a corner kick.
61' Graham Potter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Soungoutou Magassa (West Ham) replacing Mateus Fernandes.

50' Guglielmo Vicario leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by James Ward-Prowse (West Ham).

47' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

45+2' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jarred Gillett blows for a foul.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

43' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
42' There's an opportunity for Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
42' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

39' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jarred Gillett with no other option than to blow for a foul.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Tottenham comes to nothing.
36' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
36' The resulting corner, taken by Xavi Simons (Tottenham), comes to nothing.
35' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
33' Jarred Gillett blows for a foul after Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
33' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) will take a corner kick.
31' Good movement by Pedro Porro (Tottenham), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
27' Djed Spence (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
24' Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.

22' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Guglielmo Vicario makes a comfortable save.
21' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
21' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
19' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Jarred Gillett due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) and his team.
18' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
18' Xavi Simons (Tottenham) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.

14' What a miss! Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
14' It looks like Max Kilman (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. Jarred Gillett won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
12' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
9' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
9' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
9' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
7' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
7' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
5' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' Mohammed Kudus (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
